name: BrowserType
label: Browser Type
description: Specifies which browser to launch (Microsoft Edge, Google Chrome, Mozilla Firefox).

selectOptions.label: Custom
selectOptions.description: Launches a custom browser by specifying its executable and driver paths.

name: LaunchWithUrl
label: Launch with Url
description: If true, launches the browser with a specific URL.

name: LaunchUrl
label: Launch Url
description: The URL to launch if Launch with Url is true.

name: BrowsingMode
label: Browsing Mode
description: Specifies whether to open in normal or private mode.

name: StoreData
label: Store Data
description: If true, stores browser data (e.g., user profiles) in a specified path. If false, uses default browser settings. this usefull when launching multiple instances of the same browser.

name: UserDataStoragePath
label: User Data Storage Path
description: Optional path to store browser data (e.g., user profiles). If not provided, a default under %APPDATA%\RPAProfileData\[BrowserType] will be used.

name: CustomBrowserName
label: Custom Browser Name
description: Name of the custom browser (required if 'Browser Type' is 'Custom').

name: BrowserExecutablePath
label: Browser Executable Path
description: Path to the  browser executable (for Custom type).

name: DriverExecutablePath
label: Driver Executable Path
description: Path to driver executable (for Custom type).

name: WindowState
label: Window State
description: Specifies the initial browser window state.

selectOptions.label: Maximized
selectOptions.description: Launches browser in maximized window state.

selectOptions.label: Minimized
selectOptions.description: Launches browser in minimized window state.

selectOptions.label: Normal
selectOptions.description: Launches browser in normal window state.

name: KillExistingBrowserInstancesMode
label: Kill Existing Browser Instances
description: Enable or disable killing existing Selenium RPA-launched browsers before starting a new one.

selectOptions.label: Enabled
selectOptions.description: Kill existing Selenium RPA browser instances before launching a new one.

selectOptions.label: Disabled
selectOptions.description: Do not kill existing Selenium RPA browser instances before launching a new one.

name: WebBrowser
label: Web Browser
description: Returns the WebDriver object for further automation steps.
